headline: Structure-guided computational design of new peptide and protein binders
label: Computational Binder Design
summary: Recent preprints and papers pair generative models with cofolding, MD and closed-loop search to produce functional binders and inhibitors.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational generation of binders and functional peptides with structure-based or physics-based evaluation inside the design loop. FlexEvo performs inference-time evolutionary adaptation of a binder against one target conformation and reports robustness across alternative protein states. PepSpace couples coarse-grained MD with a multi-objective genetic algorithm for peptide binders and condensate modulators, and nCycle-Forge applies simulated annealing with cofolding scoring to cyclic peptides containing non-canonical amino acids, yielding Thrombin and MDM2 binders from 1,472 designs. DeepTM-Bind CNN with MD simulations targets the BamA transmembrane lateral gate, and AnewDDE links structure prediction, affinity estimation and generative design in a closed loop. Generative models with DBTL cycles produced 76 thiolation domains for NRPS reprogramming. NoroScope and AVP-GPT2 are predictive rather than design-oriented. The new element is embedding cofolding and physics evaluation directly within iterative search.
